text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? When did I end up here...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To think I would lose track of my own 
whereabouts... How careless of me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The statue of the Three Goddesses...?
